answer_1.quote: We design our prompts that allow models to generate free-form text to start the response, followed by a summary and a classification label at the end of its response.
answer_1.outputs: Generated explanations, summaries, and classification labels

answer_2.quote: We select F1, precision, and recall for the positive class to measure the model performance.
